About.title: About
About.intro: I'm a Software Engineer focused on Front-End, moving into Back-End when needed and working closely across the different layers of the product. I started my career as a 3D Designer, and that background still shapes how I build: I care as much about how an interface feels as about what works behind it.
About.curiosity: I have a special interest in creative coding, performance, and how AI can be woven into visual experiences built with code. This is where I like to experiment: at the intersection of code, design, and product.
